title: Johan Lyrvall, PhD
text:
I am an assistant professor in data science at Dalarna University in Sweden.
My research is focused on methodological statistics, specifically complex latent variable modeling for multivariate categorical data. The primary research interest within this broad agenda lies in latent class analysis. Topics from my research portfolio include stepwise estimation, multilevel modeling, and dimensionality reduction.
In addition to my methodological statistics research, I contribute to applied research informing economic and political substantive scholarship.
I also maintain the R package multilevLCA for single- and multilevel latent class analysis with covariates together with Roberto Di Mari.

title: multilevLCA
text:
multilevLCA is an R package for single-level and multilevel latent class analysis with covariates developed by Roberto Di Mari and Johan Lyrvall, with contributions from Zsuzsa Bakk, Jennifer Oser and Jouni Kuha.
The package efficiently implements the two-step, two-stage, and one-step estimation approaches for latent class models with covariates based on C++ integrated routines. Moreover, it performs semi-automatic sequential and simultaneous model selection, and visualizes the output in text and figures in a user-friendly way.
